Smart Network Cycle Detector

Problem Statement:
The smart city network “MegaMart Elite SmartGrid” now supports one-way communication channels between zones.

The system forms a Directed Graph.

Due to configuration errors, circular dependencies (cycles) may form.

Your task is to determine:
Return true if a cycle exists
Otherwise return false

Use DFS with Recursion Stack logic.

Input Format
Two inputs:
1. V (number of zones)
2. E (number of directed connections)

Next E lines contain u v meaning a connection from u → v.

Output Format
Print:
true
or
false
